page.overview:
Who is Aveil?

After infiltrating the , Link overhears speaking about the which they stole from , the lead singer of the popular The Indigo-Go's Zora band; where they are and why they stole them in the first place, as he learned from Mikau. Apparently, the Skull Kid told them that the were key elements in obtaining a luxurious treasure that should be lying in the . wants the for their value as treasure, but also fears the harm done to their reputation if people would find out that they could not hold on to their loot. In order to collect the , the young Hero of Time must shoot a hanging on the ceiling of her room, causing the to come out and chase away and the other . She cannot be seen again after fleeing from the .

The Stone Mask is ineffective against , and she will alert her guards immediately upon spotting Link.

In Japanese, the name Abēru (Aveil) is supposed to be reminiscent of Nabōru (Nabooru). This was lost in the localized names.
